map.输入标准白-白视野(Humphrey 24-2/30-2)指标，分析青光眼视野损: Enter standard white-on-white perimetry (Humphrey 24-2/30-2) metrics to analyze glaucoma visual-field damage. MD/PSD may be negative or positive; enter by convention (e.g. MD = -6.5).

map.视野分析（HAP 分期）：按 MD 负值分期，大于 −6 早期、大于 −12 中: Visual-field analysis (HAP staging): stage by MD negative value, > -6 early, > -12 moderate, <= -12 late; PSD <2 no local defect, <5 suspect, >=5 marked; VFI >=95 normal, >=80 mild, >=50 moderate, <50 severe.
map.仅有旁中心暗点或鼻侧阶梯: Only paracentral scotoma or nasal step
map.PSD 反映局部缺损(p<5% 即有意义)；VFI 是按百分比的总体指标，常用于: PSD reflects local defect (p<5% is meaningful); VFI is a percentage overall metric, often used to track progression. MD's p-value needs the age-normal database.
map.⚠️ 视野分析仅为辅助解读，单次视野变异大，需结合 OCT/视神经及多次复查综合: ⚠️ Visual-field analysis is only auxiliary interpretation; a single field has large variance, so combine OCT/optic-nerve and repeated exams, and follow up with ophthalmology.
map.依据 HAP 分级、PSD 显著性与 GHT 结果，对青光眼视野损害进行分期，辅: Based on HAP grading, PSD significance and GHT result, stage glaucoma visual-field damage and aid report interpretation.
map.综合 MD、PSD、VFI 与 GHT 模式做青光眼分级。: Combine MD, PSD, VFI and GHT pattern for glaucoma grading.
map.MD>−2 且 PSD<2 且 VFI≥95 判正常。: MD>-2 and PSD<2 and VFI>=95 is judged normal.
map.MD 明显负、PSD 高、VFI 降，判中期青光眼视野损害；pct = (−6): MD clearly negative, PSD high, VFI down, judged moderate glaucoma field damage; pct = (-6)/30×100 = 20% defect.
map.各项近正常，GHT 正常，未见明确视野损害。: All near normal, GHT normal, no clear visual-field damage.
map.视野指数（Visual Field Index），把敏感度折算为相当于健康视野的: Visual Field Index, converting sensitivity into the equivalent of a healthy field's
map.MD 与 VFI 哪个更直观？: Which is more intuitive, MD or VFI?
map.MD 为平均偏离（dB），VFI 为百分比，后者更易向患者解释整体保留度。: MD is mean deviation (dB), VFI is a percentage; the latter is easier to explain overall preservation to patients.
